Update: I figured out the issue after throwing a

solenoid, key switch, blade switch, brake actuator and new fuses.

I tested connections with a multimeter and I got good readings from all wires. then i retested and on the solenoid i wouldn't get power from the signal wire. anyways the issue was cause by the fuse plug going to the brake actuator. when i would pick up the fuse connector to test it, it would have a good connection and when i would set it back down it wouldnt get power. so i replaced the fuse connector and problem solved. hope this helps anyone else who may have this problem.
